name: tadfuq
description: Tadfuq - visual workflow automation platform (Make / n8n style)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
